claims.text: DoDI 5205.11 (2024) glossary: 'acknowledged SAP: A SAP whose existence is acknowledged, affirmed, or made known to others, but its specific details are classified.' 'unacknowledged SAP: A SAP having enhanced security measures, ensuring the existence of the program is not acknowledged.' 'waived SAP: A SAP for which the Secretary of Defense has waived applicable reporting following a determination of adverse effect to national security.'

DoDD 5205.07 (2010) glossary is more explicit on the nesting: 'waived SAP. A SAP for which the Secretary of Defense has waived applicable reporting in accordance with Reference (c) following a determination of adverse effect to national security. An unacknowledged SAP that has more restrictive reporting and access controls.' And: 'unacknowledged SAP. A SAP having protective controls ensuring the existence of the program is not acknowledged, affirmed, or made known to any person not authorized for such information.'

DoDI 5205.11 para 1.2.f makes the nesting operative: 'The Secretary of Defense may designate select unacknowledged SAPs as "waived" when it is determined that using standard procedures for reporting to Congress would adversely affect national security.' Waived is a strict subset of unacknowledged; there is no such thing as a waived acknowledged SAP.

DoDI 5205.11 Glossary: 'acknowledged SAP. A SAP whose existence is acknowledged, affirmed, or made known to others, but its specific details (technologies, materials, techniques, etc.,) are classified as specified in the applicable SCG.'

DoDI 5205.11 Glossary: 'unacknowledged SAP. A SAP having enhanced security measures ensuring the existence of the program is not acknowledged, affirmed, or made known to any person not authorized for such information.'

DoDI 5205.11 Glossary: 'waived SAP. A SAP for which the SecDef has waived applicable reporting in accordance with Reference (c) following a determination of adverse effect to national security. An unacknowledged SAP that has more restrictive reporting and access controls than other unacknowledged SAPs.'

DoDD 5205.07 (2010) Glossary: 'operations and support SAP. A SAP established primarily to protect the planning for, execution of, and support to especially sensitive military operations. An operations and support SAP may protect organizations, property, operational concepts, plans, or activities.'
DoDD 5205.07 (2010) Glossary: 'acquisition SAP. A SAP established to protect sensitive research, development, testing and evaluation, modification, and procurement activities.'
DoDI 5205.11 Glossary: 'umbrella. A SAP may also be referred to as an "umbrella" if the SAP has subordinate elements, referred as compartments, sub-compartments, or projects.'

claims.text: A legacy material-recovery and exploitation effort would map onto the taxonomy as a waived unacknowledged operations and support SAP (recovery and custody of property) with a subordinate acquisition SAP compartment (exploitation and engineering), under a single umbrella. Reasoning: the DoD definitions of operations and support SAP - expressly covering 'property' - and acquisition SAP together describe recovery-plus-reverse-engineering with no strain.

connections.note: Tier 3 because this is a reading of what the amendment does to the taxonomy, not a quotation about it. Sec. 6603's new 50 U.S.C. 3091a(b)(2)(A) bars the head of an IC element from transferring a capability out of a controlled access program, subject to the two exits at (B). The categories on this board are not merely descriptive after December 2024: Congress attached a statutory consequence to which box a capability sits in, which is what makes the CAP/SAP distinction load-bearing rather than nomenclature. The verbatim text of both subparagraphs is on the amendment node.

of.label: Acknowledged, unacknowledged and waived - the three states of a DoD SAP

desc: The three-state taxonomy is the vocabulary the whole board depends on, and it is defined word for word in DoD's own issuances. An ACKNOWLEDGED SAP is 'A SAP whose existence is acknowledged, affirmed, or made known to others, but its specific details (technologies, materials, techniques, etc.,) are classified as specified in the applicable SCG'. Its name appears in the budget; you may know that it exists and nothing else. An UNACKNOWLEDGED SAP is 'A SAP having enhanced security measures ensuring the existence of the program is not acknowledged, affirmed, or made known to any person not authorized for such information'. The correct response to an inquiry is neither confirmation nor denial; the program's very existence is classified. A WAIVED SAP is 'A SAP for which the SecDef has waived applicable reporting in accordance with Reference (c) following a determination of adverse effect to national security. An unacknowledged SAP that has more restrictive reporting and access controls than other unacknowledged SAPs' - Reference (c) being 10 U.S.C. 119. Cross-cutting the three states are three categories defined by mission: an acquisition SAP protects 'sensitive research, development, testing and evaluation, modification, and procurement activities'; an intelligence SAP protects intelligence activity; and an operations and support SAP is 'established primarily to protect the planning for, execution of, and support to especially sensitive military operations' and 'may protect organizations, property, operational concepts, plans, or activities'. A SAP with subordinate structure is called an 'umbrella', with 'compartments, sub-compartments, or projects' beneath it. The single most important observation for this board is that the alleged legacy recovery effort - if it exists - would sit precisely at the intersection of a waived unacknowledged operations and support SAP with an acquisition SAP for the exploitation work, held under an umbrella whose compartments are known only to the compartment holders. Every element of that description is an ordinary term of art in DoDI 5205.11.

entityInfo.desc: Terms of art, precisely, and why each one matters to the allegations. ACKNOWLEDGED: existence admitted, details classified. If a recovery program were acknowledged, its nickname would be in the annual report and the argument would be over. UNACKNOWLEDGED: 'enhanced security measures ensuring the existence of the program is not acknowledged, affirmed, or made known to any person not authorized'. This is the state in which a truthful official can decline to confirm or deny, and in which a denial issued by a press office staffed by people without access is a denial made in good faith by people who genuinely do not know. WAIVED: an unacknowledged SAP whose statutory reporting has been removed by the Secretary. This is the state in which the phrase 'Congress was not informed' can be simultaneously true and lawful. Cross-cutting these are the mission categories - acquisition, intelligence, and operations and support, the last defined to protect 'the planning for, execution of, and support to especially sensitive military operations' and expressly capable of protecting 'organizations, property, operational concepts, plans, or activities'. The word 'property' in an official DoD definition is the closest thing in the public policy corpus to a category designed for custody of a physical object whose existence is itself the secret. And any SAP with subordinate structure is an 'umbrella' with 'compartments, sub-compartments, or projects' - which is why a person read into one compartment can truthfully testify to what he was told about others without ever having seen a document.
